# ModDB — fan cinematic enhancement

- Original source: [Robin Hood Legend of Sherwood - 60 FPS AI VIDEOs for (all versions)](https://www.moddb.com/mods/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-60-fps-ai-videos-for-all-versions)
- Author / publication: Limafra; ModDB.
- Language / date: English; 2026-02-14.
- Access: Project description and release metadata inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Limafra describes a replacement cinematic pack made by processing existing video with AI upscaling and motion compensation. The project claims threefold image upscaling and conversion from twenty-five to sixty frames per second, with replacement files placed in the cinematics directory.

This is a fan transformation of the videos, not recovered original artwork or an engine rendering improvement. Compatibility with every edition is the creator’s claim and was not tested. The files and embedded media were not downloaded or watched, so this record makes no visual-quality assessment.
